Show less Read more Like 4 Dislike Reply · 4 replies · Hide replies · 4 replies @filmund 2 months ago What I saw tommy be in the finale I wished I saw more of this season and past. The dude can act . Unleash the Thornton Show less Read more Like 18 Dislike Reply @daraghmorrissey 2 months ago The wolf appearing near the end of the finale might mean we have another funeral in S3. I actually liked S2. I love to watch another 8 episodes of Billy Bob driving around in pickups, drinking light beer, and swearing. Show less Read more Like 13 Dislike Reply 1 reply Hide replies 1 reply @zrod1012 2 months ago What if the “& cattle” part was to connect the yellow stone spin offs or a connection to the 6’s Show less Read more Like 6 Dislike ❤ by @BrainPilot Reply @Philip-0 2 months ago (edited) Tommy is due at least two I-told-you-so moments versus Cami, and both of them may play out. The obvious one is the offshore well being a $400m dry hole. The less obvious one is where Gallino aggressively forecloses on a bankrupt M-Tex as he said to Tommy that he would, leaving Cami with nearly nothing. That could bring many more prospects into reach of CTT and Cattle. If law enforcement pressure Tommy for evidence against the Cartel then we might see Gallino's threat against "the one Tommy loves most" become a reality. Perhaps this is why they've spent so much time keeping his wife/daughter front and center. Show less Read more Like 9 Dislike Reply @dominicm2175 2 months ago Season 3 they’ll get into the cattle business Show less Read more Like 8 Dislike Reply @stmartin17773 1 month ago (edited) See Frances Ford Coppola's letter to Marlon Brando Season 3 can start like Andor seasons started - "one year later." CTT as a sure thing seems established, so seeing it operating at a high level of success for a few episodes, with concurrent climax of M-Tex drilling: 'will it hit or not' will be necessary. Contrasting 9-12 months of success taken from Tommy in 2008, with the stress Cami will be feeling after 9 months of drilling required to reach the gas field. Organic development of the romantic relationships is easy to imply and not necessary to show. M-Tex fails, Charlie becomes employed by CTT. 'One Year Later' means 100s of millions in revenue for CTT, this will possibly introduce Dragon Sickness somewhere, i.e. greed will attract Dragons either internally or externally. E.g Banks wanting to give cheap (for now) debt-money to CTT to get hooks in the real property that CTT now is. Danny's friends similarly as lever for rapid expansion. Danny will want political power to fully extricate himself and his friends from their past. So it won't be him that jeopardises his embryonic oil company. Monty met with the State Governor. Tommy will begin to have similar influence, their roles and fortunes exchanged after Tommy and Monty's equality was reversed in 2008. This permits any national political issue as subject of any episode. Danny will have his eyes on this influence, for favors. Tensions rise. Tommy to Cami earlier "we look like the engine of their money laundering machine" ..... His warning was disregarded because of love of family as it is. This is The Godfather. The story of the effects of amoral enterprise capitalism "nothing personal just business"will have to be theologically coherent - and show the natural reward of putting second things first, rather than putting first things first.[See CS Lewis 'First and Second Things] Love of God. Matt 6:24-37. The setting for Season 3 shouldn't be too dissimilar to Season 2 given Tommy's daily interactions were for a company that was able to attract 1.3 billion in debt. It's just that now he will own/control his own company of similar size. All the characters will be significantly wealthier or just come into significant wealth at the 12month mark "..money ruins more families than it fixes" [Tommy to Cooper S2ep02] Rebecca will want to share this wealth with Charlie. Ariana could be pregnant by the start of S3. Danny will recruit Tommy to help carve up M-Tex. "Too much money ruins families" Ali Larter's character could be the one to grow most soul seeing her children not handle it well and reflecting on her own attachments. She will also become a real estate mogul. The Norris family join the Ft Worth billionaire club. CTT's revenues valuing it in the billions. The Sharks who "leave a big wake" will flatter to deceive if they smell any blood in the water from one of the character's weaknesses. The original contract is with Cooper, so he will be a pressure point. Show less Read more Like 3 Dislike Reply @BudKnocka 1 month ago A coyote could mean human trafficking… Show less Read more Like 2 Dislike Reply @Alieh86 1 month ago I think Charlie was a plot point. They wanted to show Rebecca wasn’t a cyborg. It also set up the awesome scene where Tommy told her he would always have her back. TS doesn’t usually give many characters flowery love stories, but he does like to create a close knit group of people who become like family. You could see that light switch when Rebecca went to bat for Cooper. She returned to the “life-ruiner” lawyer mode, but this time she was doing it because it was personal, not business. It also foreshadowed the end when Tommy “appointed” everyone their positions at CTT. Hopefully Charlie disappears into the sea or she realizes that she can’t be in a relationship with him because he works for mtex.
